blocks.acc_title: Two lineages meet only at settle
blocks.acc_description: Claude and Codex explore without a shared context edge; they converge at settle, then cross-review, gates, and PR.

blocks.markdown: The governing claim is structural: independent explore lanes meet only at settle. Approve shipping with Windows canary as explicit follow-up, or hold until that canary is green.

items.label: Cross-lineage review
items.detail: Findings addressed on the integration branch

columns.title: Ship now
columns.markdown: Accept the Windows canary as explicit release follow-up. Structure of the delivery path is settled.

columns.title: Hold
columns.markdown: Wait until the supported native Windows canary is complete before merge.

blocks.markdown: Use **Comment** (`C`) on the figure or evidence rows if the boundary is wrong. Notes rail appears only while Comment mode is on.

blocks.prompt: Approve ship-with-follow-up, request hold until Windows canary, or mark the structural claim wrong.
